buzzRounds.topic: Wembanyama blocks 9 shots as the Spurs keep rolling
buzzRounds.whatHappened: Victor Wembanyama had 9 blocks, the most of any player in the NBA on Monday, November 9, as the San Antonio Spurs beat the Phoenix Suns 122-96. A block is when a defender swats away an opponent's shot.
buzzRounds.whyCare: Two days earlier Wembanyama scored 29 points on 13 shots in a 125-103 win over Portland that stretched San Antonio's winning streak to eight games, per NBA.com.
buzzRounds.youCouldSay: Victor Wembanyama had 9 blocks Monday night, the most of anyone in the league that day, as the Spurs beat the Suns 122-96.

details.name: Victor Wembanyama
details.buzz: Wembanyama led the NBA with 9 blocks on November 9 and scored 29 points on 13 shots on November 7, when San Antonio's win streak reached eight games, per NBA.com.
